g.text: One flip at a time (working title)
Must counting ever flip several bits at once?
Gray code: g = n XOR (n shifted right one place).
only row 0; no blank rows hint the length
Binary 3 (011) to 4 (100) flips 3 bits. In Gray code,
how many flip at 3 to 4, and in total 0 to 7?
One flip at a time (working title)
Must counting ever flip several bits at once?
Gray code: g = n XOR (n shifted right one place).
ring = lamp that changed from the row above
Hint: count up and watch how many lamps change each time.
One flip at a time (working title)
Must counting ever flip several bits at once?
Gray code: g = n XOR (n shifted right one place).
the Gray flips column is all 1s
From 3 to 4, binary flipped all three lamps; Gray
flipped one. Counting 0 to 7, binary made 11 flips,
Gray made 7: one per step. A dial sensor read halfway
between two marks is then off by one position at most.
